categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two main business lines: interconnect chip products and the JinDai® server platform product line. The interconnect chip products include memory interface chips (such as MRCD/MDB chips), memory module supporting chips, CKD chips, PCIe Retimer chips, and MXC chips. The JinDai® server platform includes JinDai® CPUs and hybrid secure memory modules (HSDIMM®). Additionally, the company is developing AI chips to meet growing AI computing demands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary integrated circuit design platforms encompassing digital signal processing, memory management, data buffering, analog circuit design, high-speed logic and interface circuits, and low-power design technologies. It has pioneered the DDR4 full-buffer '1+9' architecture adopted as an international JEDEC standard, evolved into the DDR5 '1+10' framework. The company also develops high-speed SerDes IP for PCIe 5.0/CXL 2.0 Retimer chips and leads in CXL memory expansion controller (MXC) chip technology. Manufacturing is outsourced under a fabless model, focusing on design and R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global memory manufacturers such as Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, as well as leading cloud computing and internet companies. The company's products serve the server, cloud computing, AI, HPC, data center, and PC markets, with applications in AI servers, storage devices, and hardware accelerators. The JinDai® server platform targets the domestic Chinese market, including government, finance, and transportation sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with operations and subsidiaries in China (Shanghai, Kunshan, Hainan), the United States, Macau, Hong Kong, and the Cayman Islands. Its sales are primarily international, with a significant portion of revenue generated from overseas markets, while the JinDai® server platform mainly serves the domestic Chinese market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Operating as a fabless semiconductor design company, the company is positioned upstream in the supply chain, focusing on chip design and R&D. It outsources wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors. The company procures wafers and packaging/testing services from suppliers and sells finished chips to memory module manufacturers and server OEMs downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in high-performance, low-power chip design for cloud computing and AI applications. Strategic R&D focuses include advancing DDR5 memory interface chips and their iterations, developing high-bandwidth interconnect chips such as PCIe Retimers and MXC CXL controllers, and evolving the JinDai® server CPU platform. The company is also developing next-generation AI chips to address emerging AI workload demands. It actively participates in international standards organizations like JEDEC and CXL Alliance to lead industry standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuits including memory interface chips, interconnect chips, server CPUs, and related modules. The company also earns licensing fees from intellectual property and collects royalties. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to major memory manufacturers, server OEMs, and cloud service providers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in memory interface chips and interconnect chip solutions, competing with major players such as Renesas Electronics and Rambus. It is one of the few suppliers worldwide offering complete DDR5 memory interface and supporting chip solutions. In PCIe Retimer chips, it is among the top three global suppliers and the second to mass-produce PCIe 5.0/CXL 2.0 Retimers. The company holds significant influence in JEDEC standards and leads in CXL memory expansion controller technology, positioning it strongly in emerging AI infrastructure markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.29 billion, a 37.76% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to global server and computer industry demand downturn and customer inventory reductions. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 450.9 million, down 65.3% year-over-year. Despite short-term declines, the company maintains strong R&D investment (29.83% of revenue) and expects growth driven by DDR5 adoption and AI-related chip demand. The company has total assets of about RMB 10.7 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.19 billion as of year-end 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary high-speed, low-power chip design technologies and comprehensive DDR2 to DDR5 memory interface solutions, recognized as international standards. Its products offer superior performance, stability, and energy efficiency, supporting high bandwidth and large capacity memory systems critical for AI and cloud computing. The company’s PCIe Retimer and CXL MXC chips provide advanced high-bandwidth, low-latency interconnect solutions essential for AI servers. The JinDai® server platform uniquely integrates real-time security monitoring, offering secure, reliable computing tailored for domestic markets. Its strong patent portfolio and leadership in industry standards further differentiate its offerings.
